_instructions._comment: Bootstrap configuration - infrastructure as code with three-state architecture
_states: State 1 (COLD): No infrastructure exists - requires direct AWS credentials + GitHub PAT in GitHub Secrets
State 2 (WARM): Infrastructure exists - uses OIDC authentication + retrieves GitHub PAT from AWS Secrets Manager
State 3 (DESTROY): Infrastructure destroys itself using OIDC authentication
checklist: - Attach policy: AdministratorAccess (or PowerUserAccess + IAM permissions)
- Create access key and save credentials
- Required scopes: admin:org (for runner registration) and repo (for managing GitHub Secrets)
- GH_RUNNER_PAT (from step 2) - NOTE: Must NOT start with GITHUB_
5. Commit and push to trigger bootstrap
Once infrastructure exists, the bootstrap system is SELF-SUFFICIENT:
- GitHub Secrets are AUTOMATICALLY DELETED during bootstrap
- Workflow uses OIDC to authenticate with AWS
- GitHub PAT is retrieved from AWS Secrets Manager
- System runs on PURE OIDC - no human credentials needed
- Subsequent runs will use OIDC automatically
3. Commit and push to destroy infrastructure
- If infrastructure exists (warm state): uses OIDC to destroy itself
- If infrastructure doesn't exist: skips (nothing to destroy)
